pixel_processing: None. Original output bytes copied without resizing, cropping, compositing, or retouching.

alpha_qa.notes: Faint alpha specks may expand raw nonzero bbox. Threshold bounds are read-only QA and registration hints; no pixels were changed.

geometry_review.coordinate_system: Original PNG pixels, x right, y down. Endpoint selections estimated visually, not mathematically exact.
geometry_review.suggested_css_matrix_meaning: [a,b,c,d,e,f]; fits ONLY selected lines using x_new=x and y_new=b*x+d*y. Use transform-origin 0 0 and recompute image/anchor bounds. This is a registration suggestion, not an applied pixel edit.
geometry_review.confidence: Approximate visual QA; verify at runtime
geometry_review.notes: Approximate hand-read tabletop corners. Opposite back long edge from [335,74] to [1753,560] has slope about 0.343 versus selected front 0.368: image is not mathematically orthographic. Fit gives selected edges exactly 2:1 but other edges retain small residuals.
